title: Hedgehog holding a balloon
svg:

  <circle cx='76' cy='66' r='3' fill='#5a3a6a'/>

  <circle cx='64' cy='63' r='3.5' fill='#3a2a5a'/>

  <path d='M60 76 Q62 68 58 62' stroke='#c8a06a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M57 48 Q52 45 54 50 Q52 55 57 52 Q62 55 60 50 Q62 45 57 48 Z' fill='#ffdd55'/>
